q: In March 2025, what multiplier was paid for day D2 work in hour band H2? Answer under the version of the overtime rate that was in force on that date.
log:
March 2025 falls in the 2024-07-01 to 2025-12-31 window, so the answer is in `hard-overtime-v2`, indexed by two qualifiers (day and hours — no place qualifier in that version).
